rows.note: Use this as the all-purpose choice for an impressive, heroic, or noteworthy feat.

example.english: Jumping into the sea to save someone was truly a heroic deed.
example.traditional: 佢跳入海救人，真係一項壯舉。
example.jyutping: keoi5 tiu3 jap6 hoi2 gau3 jan4 zan1 hai6 jat1 hong6 zong3 geoi2

rows.note: Use this for a morally noble or righteous deed, rather than merely an impressive feat.

example.english: Donating all the prize money was truly a noble deed.
example.traditional: 佢捐出全部獎金，實在係一項義舉。
example.jyutping: keoi5 gyun1 ceot1 cyun4 bou6 zoeng2 gam1 sat6 zoi6 hai6 jat1 hong6 ji6 geoi2

rows.note: Use this in Hong Kong for the title deed of a flat or house.

example.english: When I bought the flat, the solicitor told me to check the title deed carefully.
example.traditional: 買樓嗰陣，律師話要先睇清楚樓契。
example.jyutping: maai5 lau4 go2 zan6 leot6 si1 waa6 jiu3 sin1 tai2 cing1 co2 lau4 kai3

rows.note: Use this formal legal term for a deed as an executed legal instrument, rather than specifically a house title deed.

example.english: The relevant deed of transfer has been signed by both parties.
example.traditional: 有關轉讓契據已由雙方簽署。
example.jyutping: jau5 gwaan1 zyun2 joeng6 kai3 geoi3 ji5 jau4 soeng1 fong1 cim1 cyu5
